name: Arjun, the Metro Techie
tagline: Big city, big salary growth, big layoff nerves.
story: First in the family to graduate. Landed a software job in Bengaluru, sends money home, and is already getting calls from recruiters. Income can jump fast here, and so can the risks.

provenance.basis: Illustrative: typical fresher package at an Indian product company, mid-2020s. Base pay growth of 6.3% a year is nominal: about 1.8 points above the 4.5% average inflation, the same real growth as when it was 7% against 5.2% inflation.
